column7: While the password-reset per-IP budget runs on its in-memory storage fallback (per replica), it now allows half the per-IP limit (TestPasswordResetBudget_DuringFallbackHalvesThePerIPLimit) and caps reset emails per account (this test: 4 requests from 4 IPs past the resend interval deliver 2). Red on #3029: both fail (full limit; 3+ delivered). Andrei 2026-10-10 18:52 (AUTH-AUDIT-1 item 5 point 2): email-bombing guard during fallback. Replica divisor: TestAuthBudgetFallback_ReplicaDivisorScalesTheLimit; /health degraded flag: server/http/handlers TestHealth_ReportsTheAuthRateLimitFallback.
